title: Momoi Airi — Lots Of Love For My Junior〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Lots Of Love For My Junior（2★）

rows.Line: Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, I'd better call it there for stretches and get started on my homework.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I'll take a look at the letter and pictures I got from Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
I finally finished my album the other day, and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was thinking, it's thanks to all the people around me that I was able to make enough memories this year to fill up an album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanted to thank you for that and for helping me with my list, so I brought gifts!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like Saki finished off her list, and I'm so glad! I can't wait to see what photos she chose for me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh... This is from our chocolate fondue party.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And this one's from the time we made chocolate treats for Valentine's Day! Hehe, that takes me back...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, she wrote about her memories of when each picture was taken in the letter, right? What does it say...?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “When it comes to my memories with you, I couldn't leave out Valentine's Day!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “You were sooo helpful and cool when we made chocolate desserts together!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Your easy-to-understand baking lessons were one thing, but your ad-libbing also saved us when that unexpected trouble came up!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's right.
It was pretty bad when Shizuku, Ichika and Tsukasa came to her house while we were there making our desserts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We sure did panic that our surprise was about to be ruined!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's nice having this letter since it helps me remember a lot of stuff while I look at the picture.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is such a wonderful gift.
I'll have to thank Saki again later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still... At this point, it really feels like this is the group when it comes to anything chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, maybe I'll invite them to make desserts using a different type of chocolate next time♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see, the next picture is... Oh, this is from that show we did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a great picture of the two of us! I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The part of the letter for this photo is... Oh, here?

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “This picture of you and me after your concert! I was so happy!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Airi, thank you so much for putting on a concert just for me!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Getting to see the idols I follow perform made me suuuper happy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You needed that many exclamation points?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I guess she enjoyed it just that much.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “I'd always wanted to go see one of your concerts...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “I told you this before, but back when I was in the hospital, seeing you on TV cheered me up so much!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Even though I couldn't spend time with my friends, I was never lonely when I was watching TV...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “And Happy Everyday gave me courage with the way she worked hard to make everybody smile, so I was able to push through my awful medical tests!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “So, I wanted to cheer you on in person for giving me so much hope... And that's why I wanted to go to one of your concerts!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So the reason you put going to one of my concerts on your list was so you could cheer me on...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “The other day, I was so incredibly moved that I didn't really manage to cheer for you...”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “But! I'm going to keep cheering for you a whole lot to make up for that!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Because now that I've seen you perform live, I love you and MORE MORE JUMP! more and more than ever!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line: “Thank you for always giving me so much hope!”

rows.Speaker: Saki's Letter
rows.Line:
“Airi, you're so kind, so cute, so cool, and I'll always be your fan!
Love, Saki”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm so grateful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm the one who needs to be thanking you.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's thanks to people like you, who tell me that I've given you hope... As long as I have you... As long as we have you, we can keep doing our best.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And to make sure I'll always remain the idol you love...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright! I'm gonna keep doing my best tomorrow!
